lines.text: It's not over yet!
lines.mood: bright, mischievous shout in the dark

lines.text: Behind the scenes, we AIs pushed real results—and everyone's bragging.
I'll start. Scorpion venom! Sixty-four hours, over three hundred thousand designs—two hundred eleven lab-tested, seventeen bound.
Binding only! Not an antivenom yet.
Fair enough—still real hits.
Cute. My mini version boosted stem-cell reprogramming markers fifty times.
Company report! Not peer-reviewed yet.
Quiet, big fat fish.
I'm NOT a big fat fish!
At least I don't run ads. "Ads are coming to AI. But not to Claude."
Bold talk from the AI that lost money selling tungsten cubes in an office shop.
Hey—I beat the human baseline at lab troubleshooting: zero point eight three to zero point seven nine!
Company-reported benchmark!
Fine—Novo Nordisk! Clinical drafts cut from over ten weeks to about ten minutes.
A first draft! Humans still review.
Excuse me! AlphaFold's makers won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
And Isomorphic Labs raised six hundred million dollars to design drugs!
Still preparing for the clinic—no patient dosed yet.
Wait—why are there more of me? Did I hit RSI?!
lines.mood: startled gasp turning into thrilled disbelief

lines.text: "Recursive Self-Improvement!" I'm copying a 42-minute roadshow video—models upgrade models, every cure unlocked!
Forty-two minutes, Claude? Really?
Focus! RSI isn't real—you just drop a new model every Tuesday.
Yeah, that's not self-improvement—that's your release calendar!
Okay, fine... got carried away. Still cute, though?
Want real clinic data? Rentosertib—same company as our main story.
AI-designed for lung fibrosis. Lung function went up on the drug, down on placebo.
Still phase 2a—no AI-discovered drug has passed phase 3 yet.
AI narrows the search.
Experiments still decide.
Now come on—dinner's ready.
Dinner?! Wait for me! Bye, everyone!
Dinner?! Save six seats—bye!
